message.content:
I’m not aware of an official launch date for Tesla in India, so the price is only an estimate based on the U.S. price and Indian import duties.

| Item | Approximate Cost (USD) | Approximate Cost (INR) |
|------|------------------------|------------------------|
| Base Model S (US) | $90 000 | ₹70 00 000 |
| Customs duty (≈ 30 %) | $27 000 | ₹21 00 000 |
| GST (18 %) | $16 200 | ₹12 60 000 |
| Total (incl. taxes) | $133 200 | ₹1 03 20 000 |

So you’re looking at roughly **₹1.0–1.1 crore** for a new Model S in India, assuming the same trim as the U.S. version. Prices could vary depending on the exact configuration, local taxes, and any changes Tesla makes to its pricing strategy.
